chunks.content: 96 View this email in browser SK&S Law Group What does Yesterday's FTC's Non-Compete Ban Mean for My Deal? *It's not effective yet, and substantial delays are expected from business groups who are likely to challenge it legally *It does carve out pretty much one exception: for the sale of business-what that means is currently in flux, but it is likely going to be limited to owners *If you have non-competes out there, you have an affirmative obligation to notify those people that they're no longer valid (click the blogpost below for standard approve language for this notice) Learn More Copyright © SK&S Law Group LLP.
